lead.headline: FIVE BENGALURU RESIDENTS AMONG SIX KILLED IN JOSHIMATH HELICOPTER CRASH
lead.deck: A police inspector and four other passengers from the city died on a pilgrimage flight; the pilot was also among the dead
paragraphs: Five Bengaluru residents, including a police inspector and four others, died when a helicopter returning from Badrinath crashed near Joshimath in Uttarakhand on Friday. The pilot was also killed, bringing the toll to six.

The helicopter was flying to Dehradun when it lost contact over the Joshimath valley. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has dispatched a team for a preliminary assessment, while local authorities said all six people aboard had died.
The five passengers from Bengaluru were identified as Arun Salunke, HS Nataraj, K Sudheer, Shankar Gowda and Pratap. The aircraft operator’s fleet was grounded as a precaution, according to reports.

sidebarStory.headline: NVS-03 SUCCESSFULLY PLACED IN ORBIT; NAVIC CONFIGURATION RESTORED
sidebarStory.subhead: Successful launch restores NavIC to its four-satellite minimum operational configuration, officials said
paragraphs: ISRO’s GSLV-F18 placed the next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 in its intended transfer orbit. ISRO says the satellite carries atomic clocks and adds the L1 signal to NavIC’s existing L5 and S-band signals.

stories.headline: NAMMA METRO FERRIES KIDNEY ACROSS CITY IN 37 MINUTES
stories.deck: A coordinated journey linked Kolar’s Jalappa Hospital with Fortis Hospital in Nagarbhavi
paragraphs: Namma Metro helped move a donated kidney from Jalappa Hospital in Kolar to Fortis Hospital in Nagarbhavi. The metro leg between Benniganahalli and Attiguppe took 37 minutes, with BMRCL coordinating the transfer.

stories.headline: E-KHATA CAMPS OPEN ACROSS BENGALURU TODAY
paragraphs: The Greater Bengaluru Authority’s Saturday e-Khata melas resume today, with assistance for property owners at civic offices and designated centres. Bengaluru South City Corporation lists 12 centres open from 10 am to 5 pm.

stories.headline: BESCOM PLANS MAINTENANCE OUTAGES IN 50-PLUS AREAS
paragraphs: Scheduled work at the Banashankari and Subramanyapura substations is expected to interrupt supply in more than 50 localities today. Residents are advised to check the listed maintenance timings for their area.

stories.headline: ISRO’S NVS-03 LAUNCH RESTORES NAVIC TO FOUR-SATELLITE CONFIGURATION
stories.deck: The navigation satellite carries atomic clocks and adds an L1 signal to India’s regional system
paragraphs: The GSLV-F18 mission successfully placed NVS-03 in geosynchronous transfer orbit from Sriharikota. The satellite is the third in India’s next-generation navigation series and is designed to continue NavIC services.

ISRO says NVS-03 carries indigenous and procured atomic clocks and adds an L1 signal alongside L5 and S-band signals. NavIC coverage is intended to extend across India and about 1,500 kilometres beyond its borders.

stories.headline: INDIA BLOC SETS “PUBLIC IMPEACHMENT” OF CEC FOR TODAY
paragraphs: Opposition parties say they will hold a public protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar in New Delhi at 2:30 pm. The event was rescheduled after rain, as the INDIA bloc renews its objections to the electoral-roll revision and alleged “vote chori”.

stories.headline: TANKER WITH 27 INDIAN SAILORS HIT BY LIMPET MINES IN HORMUZ
stories.subhead: The crew extinguished an engine-room fire; the shipping minister says all are safe
paragraphs: A Panama-flagged crude tanker carrying 27 Indian seafarers was struck by two limpet mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, according to Reuters reporting cited by NDTV. The blast caused an engine-room fire, which the crew put out.
Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal said all sailors were safe and uninjured. Authorities are monitoring the crew and coordinating with the ship manager.

stories.headline: ROAD WORK BEGINS IN RUDRAPPA LAYOUT AFTER TWO-YEAR WAIT
stories.deck: Residents had waited two years for work to begin in the layout
paragraphs: Road work has begun in Bengaluru’s Rudrappa Layout after a two-year delay. The project is expected to improve local connectivity.

stories.headline: WEEKLY E-KHATA MELAS RESUME ACROSS THE CITY
paragraphs: Greater Bengaluru Authority e-Khata assistance camps restart today and are set to run every Saturday. Residents can seek help with new applications and khata conversion at civic corporation offices and other identified locations.

stories.headline: KARNATAKA RATNA HONOURS FOR VISHNUVARDHAN AND B. SAROJADEVI
paragraphs: The state’s highest civilian award will be presented in Bengaluru to actors Dr. Vishnuvardhan and B. Sarojadevi, according to the city report. The announcement comes ahead of Karnataka Rajyotsava.

stories.headline: NEW ZEALAND BEATS INDIA BY 87 RUNS IN FOURTH T20I
stories.deck: Glenn Phillips hit 107 and Jacob Duffy took four wickets as the hosts claimed their first win of the series
paragraphs: Glenn Phillips struck 107 as New Zealand posted 259 for 7 in Auckland, its highest T20I total. India were bowled out at 172 for 9, with Jacob Duffy taking four wickets.
India had already secured the five-match series 3-0. The teams meet for the final T20I in Hamilton on November 1.

stories.headline: FIFTH T20I AGAINST NEW ZEALAND SET FOR NOVEMBER 1
paragraphs: India and New Zealand will play the final match of their five-game T20I series in Hamilton on Sunday. India lead the series 3-1 after New Zealand’s 87-run win in the fourth match.
